youtube.title: Why Lego Bricks Are Hollow Underneath 🧱 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The first Lego bricks of 1949 had studs on top and were hollow underneath, but they gripped each other poorly. In 1958 Lego patented the modern brick with hollow tubes in the underside. The tubes press against the studs of the brick below, creating the clutch power that makes bricks snap together firmly yet pull apart easily.
